findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.publisher: United Nations OCHA occupied Palestinian territory
findings.affected_population_system: Disease surveillance: OCHA reports only about 4% of meningitis cases laboratory-confirmed; limited laboratory capacity delays differentiation between viral and bacterial cases. WHO recorded 692 suspected cases Oct 1–Nov 23 (476 suspected viral and 216 suspected bacterial). This is a surveillance and diagnostic-capacity follow-up, not a claim of new cases during the hourly window.
